rationale: C11 plausibly supplied the child’s governing drafting framework. It specifically requires a uniform series of “Emergency Preparedness Orders” assigning executive departments responsibility to develop civil-defense and defense-mobilization plans and programs for “all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States.” The child is precisely such an assignment to the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare and closely reproduces that formulation. It also carries forward C11’s distinctive reservation that planning authority does not itself authorize implementation. C09 is a strong secondary source for the surrounding civil-defense allocation and coordination machinery, while C08 concerns the same Secretary and medical-stockpile responsibilities but is materially narrower.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary ... shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs ... with respect to all conditions of national emergency including attack upon the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director ... shall establish a series of civil-defense and defense-mobilization planning assignments ... designed to provide for the development of civil-defense and defense-mobilization plans and programs by the several departments and agencies ... to meet all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, closely shared language implementing the exact departmental planning-assignment mechanism prescribed by C11.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Emergency plans and programs ... shall be developed as an integral part of the continuing activities of the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare ... The Secretary shall be prepared to implement all appropriate plans developed under this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The head of each department and agency assigned civil-defense and defense-mobilization functions ... shall develop the plans and programs there referred to under the policy direction and central program control of the Director.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same administrative machinery: departmental heads develop preparedness plans within centralized presidential emergency-program coordination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing in this order shall be construed as conferring authority ... to put into effect any emergency plan, procedure, policy, program, or course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order. Such authority is reserved to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Nothing in this order ... shall be construed as conferring authority to put into effect any plan, procedure, policy, program, or other course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order or the National Plan.
shared_material.explanation: The child substantially reproduces C11’s unusual limitation clause, strongly indicating direct reuse rather than merely a shared subject.
